reason: B offers the more substantive and directly testable anisotropy-engineering route, supported by evidence that Pt-containing high-entropy films can form an L10 phase with enhanced magnetocrystalline anisotropy. Its main weakness is that ~5 at.% Pt is unlikely by itself to produce extensive L10 ordering—the cited (FeCoNiMnCu)Pt system is not equivalent—whereas A provides no thermodynamic basis or specific aging window for precipitating a nominally single-phase FeCoNi alloy.
